title: Rethinking Token-wise Feature Caching: Accelerating Diffusion Transformers with Dual Feature Caching
abstract: arXiv:2412.18911v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiT) have become the dominant methods in image and video generation yet still suffer substantial computational costs. As an effective approach for DiT acceleration, feature caching methods are designed to cache the features of DiT in previous timesteps and reuse them in the next timesteps, allowing us to skip the computation in the next timesteps. Among them, token-wise feature caching has been introduced to perform different caching ratios for different tokens in DiTs, aiming to skip the computation for unimportant tokens while still computing the important ones. In this paper, we propose to carefully check the effectiveness in token-wise feature caching with the following two questions: (1) Is it really necessary to compute the so-called "important" tokens in each step? translated_title: 重新思考逐令牌特征缓存：通过双重特征缓存加速扩散变换器
translated_abstract: arXiv:2412.18911v3 公告类型：交叉替换  摘要：扩散变换器（DiT）已成为图像和视频生成中的主导方法，但仍面临大量计算成本。作为DiT加速的有效方法，特征缓存技术旨在缓存先前时间步中的DiT特征，并在后续时间步中重用这些特征，从而跳过后续步骤的计算。其中，逐令牌特征缓存被引入，用于对DiT中的不同令牌执行不同的缓存比例，目的是跳过不重要令牌的计算，同时仍计算重要令牌。本文提出通过以下两个问题仔细检查逐令牌特征缓存的有效性：（1）在每个步骤中，真的有必要计算所谓的“重要”令牌吗？（2）所谓的重要令牌真的重要吗？令人惊讶的是，本文给出了一些反直觉的答案，表明...
tldr: 本文质疑逐令牌特征缓存的有效性，通过反直觉的发现表明，所谓的“重要”令牌可能无需每一步都计算，并提出了双重特征缓存方法以加速扩散变换器。
en_tdlr: This paper questions the effectiveness of token-wise feature caching, revealing counter-intuitive findings that so-called "important" tokens may not need computation at every step, and proposes a dual feature caching method to accelerate diffusion transformers.
